procedures.name: geocode_city
procedures.description: Resolve a city or place name to latitude, longitude, country and timezone.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Call the Open-Meteo geocoding API with the city name.
2. Take the first match.
3. If nothing matches, ask the user to spell the place or add a country.

procedures.name: get_weather_forecast
procedures.description: Current weather (temperature, humidity, wind, rain) and a 3-day forecast for a city.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Geocode the city.
2. Call Open-Meteo forecast with current and daily fields, timezone=auto.
3. Report units (°C, km/h, mm).

procedures.name: get_air_quality
procedures.description: Current air quality (US AQI, PM2.5, PM10) for a city.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Geocode the city.
2. Call Open-Meteo air-quality API.
3. Interpret AQI bands (0-50 good, 51-100 moderate, 101-150 unhealthy for sensitive groups, >150 unhealthy).

procedures.name: get_fx_rate
procedures.description: Latest exchange rate between two currencies (ISO codes such as USD, INR, EUR).
procedures.steps_md:
1. Normalise currency names to ISO-4217 codes.
2. Call Frankfurter /latest.
3. Note the rate date (ECB publishes on working days).

procedures.name: convert_amount
procedures.description: Convert an amount of money from one currency to another at the latest rate.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Get the FX rate.
2. Multiply amount by rate.
3. Round to 2 decimals and state the rate date.

procedures.name: get_recent_earthquakes
procedures.description: Recent earthquakes (last 30 days) within 500 km of a city, newest first.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Geocode the city.
2. Query the USGS feed by radius.
3. Summarise magnitude, place and time.

procedures.name: get_crypto_price
procedures.description: Spot price of a cryptocurrency (CoinGecko id, e.g. bitcoin, ethereum) in a fiat currency.
procedures.steps_md:
1. Map the coin name to its CoinGecko id (lower-case).
2. Use a lower-case vs_currency such as usd or inr.

procedures.name: city_conditions_brief
procedures.description: Composite: weather plus air quality for a city, for 'is it a good day to go out' questions.
procedures.steps_md: Run get_weather_forecast and get_air_quality in parallel (both need geocode_city first), then give a go/no-go summary.
